facts.business: Artefact Projects Limited provides infrastructure services including project management consultancy, engineering design, and supervision services for roads, bridges, buildings, and urban infrastructure projects.
facts.related_party_note: Loans to related parties for business purpose: Nil as at March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025. During the year loans and trade advances amounting to Rs. 2532.97 Lakhs was recovered from body corporates and Rs. 2599.16 Lakhs was paid to them.
